primary_hypothesis_and_failure.hypothesis: One mature KL-warmup optimization-path intervention may improve fixed-checkpoint stochastic persequence reconstruction while preserving deterministic reconstruction/length and stochastic class-balanced recall. A diagnostic gap cannot identify early KL pressure or posterior-sigma causality.
primary_hypothesis_and_failure.primary_quantity: mean_i mean_k accuracy_nonPAD(S_ik,x_i); training and each terminal are reported separately; persequence mean is not AA macro or residue micro.
primary_hypothesis_and_failure.minimum_effect_for_further_investment: All four required versus frozen constant-beta1 at the same complete dev41 and same8epsilon bank: (1) mean stochastic persequence nonPAD accuracy improves >=0.05; (2) mean-path persequence nonPAD accuracy does not decline; (3) mean-path lengthMAE<=0, i.e. stays0; (4) stochastic supported-AA macro recall does not decline. M−S gap change is reported as descriptive only.
failure: Any incomplete/nonfinite/route or coupling failure => invalid experiment, retainallslots; no automatic retry.
